<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def reds(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','g','G'):
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            out.append((n['color'],(r0,c0,r1,c1),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
print('before SPACE reds:', reds(current_frame))
r=action(['SPACE'])
print('after SPACE: done=',r.get('done'),'level_completed=',r.get('level_completed'),'game_over=',r.get('game_over'))
print('after SPACE reds:', reds(current_frame))
W=[n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>100]
for n in W:
    r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']);r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    print('white bbox',(r0,c0,r1,c1),'px',n['pixels'])
</parameter>
</function>

def reds(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','g','G'):
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            out.append((n['color'],(r0,c0,r1,c1),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
